summary: Retested the 5 fixes from iteration 41 plus a regression check, using 1 real generation via the API (71s). Backend pytest: 17/18 pass. Fix 1 (IDOR) works: a foreign person_path or garment_path on /tryon/generate, and a foreign person_path on /outfit/generate, end with GET render-jobs 403 'Accesso negato'; own paths pass. Fix 2 works for sequential requests: while a job is running, all 6 render endpoints return 409 with the exact message. The real render also got 409 on a second POST, and after it finished a new POST was accepted. Running jobs older than 10 minutes do not block. BUT 8 simultaneous POSTs were all accepted (8x 200), so the race is not closed. Fix 3 works: the TTL index expires_at_1 exists and new jobs get expires_at = started_at + 1 day. After a backend restart, a job left running returns 500 'Generazione interrotta, riprova.'. Fix 4 mostly works: the real render is 1536x2075 instead of 2579 tall, the bottom bands are gone and the signature sits on the photo. A thin near-flat light-grey strip (~85 rows, about 4%) is still at the top. Fix 5 works: on desktop TryOnDetail the save button text is white rgb(255,255,255) on rgb(26,26,26), it is in the right column above the action buttons at y=426 with no scrolling, and clicking it downloads myatelier-<ts>.jpg with the 'Foto salvata' toast. On mobile it sits below the fold, which is expected for a stacked layout.

minor.issue: The 1-running-job check is not atomic. It does find_one and then insert_one, so 8 parallel POSTs were all accepted. A FREE user can still go past the quota by sending requests at the same time. Fix: use an atomic guard, e.g. a unique partial index on render_jobs {user_id} with partialFilterExpression {status:'running'} and catch DuplicateKeyError -> 409, or an atomic find_one_and_update lock on the user doc. Note that the 10-minute stale window would then need explicit cleanup, e.g. flip stale running jobs to error before inserting.

In the real render, about 85 near-flat rows remain at the top (row std 1.3-3.0, mean about 169). They are visible as a lighter strip above the mirror frame. The flatness threshold (std<1.5 on the 256px downscale) plus the requirement that means stay within 2 stops the trim early on a slightly noisy or gradient pad. Consider a looser std (about 3) or a per-row tolerance against the band mean. Also note the trim may crop legitimately plain backdrops in the top 8%; this is low risk.

action_items: Make the one-running-job guard atomic (unique partial index on user_id where status='running', or an atomic lock) so concurrent POSTs cannot bypass the quota
Optional: relax the _trim_pad_bands flatness threshold so slightly noisy leftover pad strips at the top are also removed
critical_code_review_comments: _start_render_job race: check-then-insert without atomicity (confirmed by test_concurrent_posts_only_one_accepted)

watermark() calls JPEG save with optimize=True. With very high-entropy content, Pillow raised 'broken data stream / Suspension not allowed here' on a synthetic noise image. Real photos are fine, but wrapping the save, or retrying without optimize on OSError, would be safer
startup() marks ALL running jobs as error. This is fine with a single worker, but with multiple uvicorn workers or replicas a restart of one would kill jobs that are still running in another

rca of the issue: Race: _start_render_job does db.render_jobs.find_one(running) and then insert_one. Concurrent requests all see no running job before any insert lands. Reproduce: send 8 parallel POSTs to /api/tryon/generate -> 8x 200.
